n, k, MO = map(int, input().split())

def power(base, exp, mod):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return result

if n % 2 == 1:
    print(power(k, n, MO))
    exit()

factorial = [1] * (n + 1)
inv_factorial = [1] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    factorial[i] = (factorial[i - 1] * i) % MO

inv_factorial[n] = power(factorial[n], MO - 2, MO)

for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
    inv_factorial[i] = (inv_factorial[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % MO

t = n
a = []
for i in range(21):
    if t & 1:
        a.append(1 << i)
    t >>= 1

S_size = 1 << len(a)
S = [0] * S_size
for i in range(S_size):
    for j in range(len(a)):
        if (i >> j) & 1:
            S[i] += a[j]

p = [-1] * S_size
for i in range(S_size):
    t_idx = -1
    for j in range(21):
        if (i >> j) & 1:
            t_idx = j
    p[i] = (1 << (t_idx + 1)) + i

f = [[0] * S_size for _ in range(k + 1)]
f[0][0] = 1

for i in range(k):
    for j in range(S_size):
        if f[i][j]:
            k_idx = p[j]
            while k_idx < S_size:
                diff = S[k_idx ^ j]
                inv_val = inv_factorial[diff]
                f[i + 1][k_idx] = (f[i + 1][k_idx] + f[i][j] * inv_val) % MO
                k_idx = (k_idx + 1) | j

ans = 0
for i in range(k + 1):
    comb = (factorial[k] * inv_factorial[i] % MO) * inv_factorial[k - i] % MO
    ans = (ans + f[i][S_size - 1] * comb) % MO

ans = (ans * factorial[n]) % MO
total = power(k, n, MO)
result = (total - ans + MO) % MO
print(result)
